title: DIY Scanning Electron Microscope - Overview
summary: Ben Krasnow shows the first image from his home-built scanning electron microscope, after months of work, and walks through how the parts operate together.
why: Used as an example of Applied Science pushing the limits of garage engineering, in DIY microscope threads.

quote.text: Ben Karsnow's channel is really inspiring. With every video, he pushes the limits of what I thought it was possible to do in your garage.
